verdict.rationale: Belvo documents its own drop-in component, a "Customizable Connect Widget" listed alongside a "No-code solution", and its docs describe links as the connected-account object. But the evidence never shows the end-to-end flow the story describes. Missing for 10: documented server-side session/access-token creation, widget open/embed instructions, the widget returning a link ID/token to the developer, confirmation that the widget handles institution selection UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let a user connect their bank with a drop-in hosted flow — create a session server-side, open the widget, and get back a token for the connected account — without building institution UI myself

citations.quote: make use of the `external_id` parameter when creating links as this will allow you to have your own unique identifier for a link in your own database
